topic: What payload transponder allocation strategies balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands from ML traffic classification?
response: To balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands from ML traffic classification, adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) and dynamic power allocation (DPA) strategies can be employed. AMC adjusts modulation and coding schemes based on channel conditions, while DPA dynamically allocates power to prioritize traffic with higher QoS requirements. This approach leverages standards like DVB-S2 and DVB-RCS2, which support AMC and DPA.
